win.window-filter.description: Routes incoming messages based on whether the currently active Windows foreground window matches the process name or title.

in.label: Message
in.description: Incoming message to route based on the active foreground window.

match.label: Match
match.description: Emitted when the active window matches.

noMatch.label: No Match
noMatch.description: Emitted when the active window does not match.

processName.label: Process
processName.description: Process name to match (with or without .exe; case-insensitive exact or substring).

titleContains.label: Title
titleContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match in the window title.

invert.label: Invert Match
invert.description: Swap Match and No Match outputs so everything except the specified window matches.

win.window-target.description: Finds a target window by process name or title, optionally brings it to the foreground, and attaches targetWindow metadata to the message basket.

in.label: Message
in.description: Incoming message that triggers window lookup and optional focusing.

found.label: Found
found.description: Emitted when the target window is found (and focused if enabled).

notFound.label: Not Found
notFound.description: Emitted if no matching window is open.

titleContains.label: Title
titleContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match in the target window title.

focus.label: Bring to Front
focus.description: Activate the window before forwarding the message (useful before Keyboard Output).

waitAfterFocusMs.label: Focus Wait (ms)
waitAfterFocusMs.description: Short pause after focusing (0–2000 ms) so the target window is ready to receive input.

win.window-post-text.description: Sends text in the background via Win32 PostMessage(WM_CHAR) without switching focus. Works best with classic Win32 / Edit controls; modern apps (Electron, games) usually need Focus Window + Keyboard Output.

in.label: Text
in.description: Text payload to post to the target window in the background.

sent.label: Sent
sent.description: Emitted after WM_CHAR messages are posted to the target window.

notFound.label: Not Found
notFound.description: Emitted if no target window is resolved or posting fails.

active.label: Active (Post)
active.description: Uncheck to mute background posting without disconnecting the wire.

processName.label: Process
processName.description: Leave empty to reuse targetHwnd placed in the basket by Focus Window.

titleContains.label: Title
titleContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match in the target window title.

childClass.label: Child Class
childClass.description: Optional Win32 child control class name to receive WM_CHAR (empty = auto-detect Edit/RichEdit/Scintilla).
